subject: Bluebridge: service-surface degradation after variant update
messages:
From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@bluebridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bluebridge Support <support@bluebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push

Vanessa / Redwood team,

We pushed live this morning (00:45 UTC) and immediately started seeing a sharp degradation in user-facing latency and a burst of 5xx errors across our recommendation endpoint. Metrics: p99 jumped from ~180ms to ~720ms; throughput dropped ~35%; and we hit an on-call CPU/Decode timeout pattern that correlates with the new model variant.

We are currently routing ~40% traffic to the new variant labeled "sparrow-lite-int8-v5.2" (per your rollout plan). We've attached a short perf trace and our SLO dashboard. The incident started at 00:50 UTC and continues. Can you please triage, pause the rollout, or route traffic away while we investigate? This is impacting checkout conversions.

Attachments: perf_trace_20260211.zip, bluebridge_slo_dashboard.png

Please advise ASAP — we are standing by on a call if needed.

Thanks,
Amy Cheng
Head of Engineering, Bluebridge Retail
amy.cheng@bluebridge.com

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@bluebridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push

Amy — thanks for the quick note and sorry for the disruption. We're on it. I’ve copied Ben (solutions perf) and Irene (engineering lead) to take a look immediately.

Proposed immediate steps:
- We will open a 30-minute triage call (link below) and hold while we validate metrics.
- If we confirm degradation tied to sparrow-lite-int8-v5.2, we will pause routing to that variant and fail traffic back to the stable v5.1 path.
- I’ll follow up here with ETA within 15 minutes after initial checks.

Call: https://meet.redwood/incident/bluebridge-20260211 (standby)

Apologies again — we’ll get you stable.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push (internal)

Ben / Irene — forwarding customer's trace and SLO. Key facts: 40% traffic to sparrow-lite-int8-v5.2; p99 -> ~720ms; throughput -35%. Customer requests pause/rollback. They are on standby for a call.

Can you triage perf_trace_20260211.zip and confirm whether this is int8 decode kernel regressions, a memory blowup, or an autoscale shortfall? If it is the variant, we should cut traffic and revert routing ASAP (no fancy experiment rollback — full failover to v5.1 FP16). Ben, can you draft the steps I should tell the customer? Irene, if we need an emergency patch, what’s the minimum safe action?

Thanks — Vanessa

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@bluebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push

Amy / Vanessa / Irene — preliminary triage done against the perf_trace. Short summary:

- Hypothesis: the sparrow-lite-int8 runtime path (new quant kernels) introduces decode stalls for certain request-length patterns; combined with a tokenization micro-regression that increases per-request decode steps.
- Evidence: the trace shows repeated 502/504s tied to token-decode timeouts and a queuing backlog on the int8 executor. Kernel-level timestamps show spikes when softmax kernel falls back to a slower codepath under certain sequence-length/geometric attention patterns.

Immediate recommendation (actionable now):
1) Pause routing to sparrow-lite-int8-v5.2 in us-east-1 (traffic routing control): set variant weight to 0% and shift back to v5.1 FP16.
2) Enable the model_fallback policy for Bluebridge’s route so any future failover goes to v5.1 automatically.
3) Increase pod headroom by +30% while we stabilize so autoscaling doesn’t throttle during the shift.

Irene — if you approve, ops can run the weight flip (step 1) now. I will coordinate the routing and validate traces post-change. I recommend we do NOT attempt a hotfix to the int8 kernels during the incident window; instead we stop the experiment and open a follow-up kernel debugging ticket.

Attachments: variant_diff.txt (binary diff summary), note:perf_trace_20260211.zip diagnostics attached above.

— Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@bluebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push

Agree with Ben’s plan. Ops executed the traffic weight flip at 10:02 PST; verified variant weight for sparrow-lite-int8-v5.2 -> 0% and v5.1 -> 100% for Bluebridge route in us-east-1. Post-change checks:

- p99 dropped back to ~210ms within 6 minutes; throughput recovered to ~95% of baseline; 5xx count returned to normal.
- We’ve left a short monitoring window (30m) before marking the incident closed.

Follow-up actions:
- Engineering will open a dedicated kernel/quant debug ticket and preserve the failing artifacts (JIRA-REQ-8793).
- Recommend we offer Bluebridge a service credit for the hour of elevated risk and the cost delta while we increased headroom. Vanessa — please confirm the credit cadence you want to offer and I will route the finance note.
- Schedule a postmortem with Bluebridge for next week (include perf traces, kernel timeline, and mitigation plan).

Amy — sorry again for the impact. We will prioritize root cause and keep you posted on remediation.

— Irene Choi
SVP, Serving Platform Engineering, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@bluebridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Bluebridge Support <support@bluebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model variant push

Thanks Vanessa / Team — confirmation that traffic reversion restored performance: p99 now ~210ms and error rates are back to baseline. We appreciate the fast response.

Please record a postmortem JIRA and include: root cause summary, timeline of events, and a mitigation plan for future variant rollouts (we'd like a stricter canary gating for mixed-precision variants). We will also open a formal credit request for the period 00:50–01:30 UTC (screenshot attached).

Attachments: bluebridge_slo_dashboard.png

Regards,
Amy Cheng
Head of Engineering, Bluebridge Retail
amy.cheng@bluebridge.com
